content: I was really disappointed with this foam mattress. After just a few weeks of use, it started to sag in the middle. I wake up every morning with a sore back, which never happened with my old spring mattress. It sleeps incredibly hot, even with very light bedding. The smell of chemicals from the foam is still strong after several months. I've tried to get in touch with customer service, but they've been very slow to respond. The edges of the mattress have held up poorly, making it difficult to sit on the side of the bed. I would not recommend this product to anyone looking for a comfortable and durable foam mattress.
